paper.title: SmartWay: Enhanced Waypoint Prediction and Backtracking for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
paper.central_claim: SmartWay 以增强的 waypoint 预测器（DINOv2、掩码交叉注意力 RGB-D 融合、占据感知损失）与带历史推理和回退动作的 GPT-4o 导航器组成零样本 VLN-CE 框架：R2R-CE 零样本 SOTA（SR 29、SPL 22.46），可缩小与监督方法差距，并在 Turtlebot 4 真机上验证。
paper.claim_scope: R2R-CE Open-Nav 100 episodes；真机 25 条作者定义指令。

evidence.quote: Experiments on R2R-CE and MP3D benchmarks show our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in zero-shot settings, demonstrating competitive results compared to fully supervised methods.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张。

evidence.quote: current waypoint predictors struggle with spatial awareness, while navigators lack historical reasoning and backtracking capabilities, limiting adaptability
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap。

evidence.quote: visual perception is abstracted by converting RGB images into textual descriptions by Vision-Language Models as an intermediary representation, resulting in an indirect and incomplete understanding of the visual environment
evidence.support_explanation: 对 Open-Nav 的批评。

evidence.quote: the waypoint predictor lacks explicit environmental constraints, making it susceptible to predicting waypoints that lead to obstacles or suboptimal paths
evidence.support_explanation: waypoint 预测器 gap。

evidence.quote: we introduce an occupancy-aware loss incorporating depth-based constraints, ensuring waypoints are placed in navigable regions and improving navigation ability
evidence.support_explanation: 占据感知损失。

evidence.quote: it processes all relevant prompts, including task description, instruction, history, observations, and action options, and outputs precisely one selected action
evidence.support_explanation: 单专家 MLLM 导航器：模型只在候选动作中选一个。

evidence.quote: Move back to last position in an opposite direction
evidence.support_explanation: 回退作为一个额外动作选项。

evidence.quote: extend our backtracking mechanism to support multi-step undo operations
evidence.support_explanation: 当前回退为单步撤销（作者列为未来工作）。

evidence.quote: following the evaluation framework of Open-Nav [ 16 ] across 100 episodes to ensure direct comparability
evidence.support_explanation: R2R-CE 仿真评测为 100 episodes。

evidence.quote: the MLLM navigator is deployed via the gpt-4o-2024-08-06 API, which serves as our zero-shot inference backend

零样本比较：同后端 MapGPT-CE-GPT4o SR 7；Open-Nav 用 GPT-4/Llama；OSR 51 vs SR 29。
